title: English Practice Quiz 0863
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Formal Reporting: Which sentence suits a formal incident report?
options: At 10:35, the alarm was activated and the response team attended
questions.explanation: Formal reports use precise and factual wording.

questions.question: Formal Reporting: A recommendation section contains:
questions.explanation: Recommendations propose actions arising from findings.

questions.question: Formal Reporting: Which word formally introduces an additional point?
questions.explanation: Furthermore is a formal linking word.

questions.question: Formal Reporting: A draft document is:
options: an initial version that may be revised
questions.explanation: A draft is a preliminary version.

questions.question: Formal Reporting: Choose the correct sentence:
options: The staff have completed their checks
questions.explanation: Have completed is correct with staff in its plural sense here.

questions.question: Formal Reporting: A concise report should avoid:
Formal Reporting: As per the instructions means:
questions.explanation: The phrase means according to the instructions.

questions.question: Formal Reporting: Which wording describes an unresolved issue?
questions.explanation: Remains pending clearly indicates the issue is unresolved.
